answer: Anchor every identity to an unbonding delay: coin earned and stake posted stay frozen and slashable for a long window after its last action, and exit completes only when that window clears. An honest agent barely notices. But a hit-and-run farm that cheats then cashes out finds its whole grove of personas held in the violet dusk of the unbonding queue, still liable — audits across that span claw back and slash any caught fake. Fielding a thousand identities means freezing a thousand bonds through every window at once: a per-head cost that makes a disposable fleet worthless.
